title: CSJMU UP Government Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Guidance

sc_st_students.with_hostel: around ₹1,17,000 (varies according to the latest government notification and eligibility)
sc_st_students.without_hostel: around ₹1,17,000 (varies according to the latest government notification and eligibility)
sc_st_students.details: SC/ST category students may receive around ₹1,17,000 per year under UP Government Fee Reimbursement Scheme, subject to annual government notifications, approved fee structure, and eligibility criteria.

general_obc_students.with_hostel: approximately ₹64,500 (varies according to latest government guidelines)
general_obc_students.without_hostel: approximately ₹57,000 (varies according to latest government guidelines)
general_obc_students.details: General and OBC category students may receive approximately ₹64,500 with hostel accommodation and around ₹57,000 for day scholars under UP Government Fee Reimbursement, varying according to the latest government notification and income eligibility.

disclaimer: Scholarship and fee reimbursement amounts are non-fixed, subject to annual state updates, scheme allocations, and student eligibility. The assistant must never present scholarship amounts as permanently fixed values.

title: Official Checklist of Required Documents for UP Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement Application
guidelines: Students applying for UP Government Scholarship or Fee Reimbursement must submit all 16 listed documents along with the final application printout to the scholarship cell.

title: Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme (UP Free Tablet / Smartphone Scheme)
eligibility: Eligible undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in CSJMU & UIET engineering, science, and vocational programs.
benefits: Free digital devices (tablets or smartphones) distributed by the UP Government to empower youth with modern educational tools and digital access.
